sections.en: Cardano is changing hands near $0.2392, +9.26% over the past 24 hours and +14.65% on a 7-day view. sections.en: Total market capitalization stands near $9.0B (CoinGecko). Reported 24-hour spot volume is $0.63B with 7-day average turnover elevated versus the trailing month (1.19x) . Note: the ETF-flow and sentiment figures above are the public Farside and alternative.me series; proprietary on-chain datasets are still left out rather than estimated. The alternative.me Fear & Greed gauge prints 70 (Greed).

**Derivatives positioning.** The public Binance futures endpoints did not answer for this asset on this cycle, so rather than fabricate a view the desk flags it as a **data gap**: funding and open-interest extremes remain the standard trigger for squeeze dynamics in Cardano.

**Trend structure.** Across horizons the picture is mixed — the moving averages are interleaved rather than stacked, which is characteristic of a transitional or range-bound regime rather than a one-way trend. Spot at $0.2391 versus EMA20 $0.2136, EMA50 $0.2040 and EMA200 $0.2437 frames the medium-term bias mechanically rather than emotionally. From this configuration the desk's working assumption is that trend-following exposure is only justified while price holds the side of the 50-day average it currently occupies.

**Key levels.** The operational map reads: initial support at $0.2292 (recent swing low); the lower Bollinger band $0.1904 as the 2σ downside envelope; upper band $0.2366 as the stretch target. Levels derived from the last ~60 sessions of closes are guides for location, not promises of reaction; they mark where prior two-way business was done and therefore where resting liquidity is most plausible. ATR(14) of $0.0124 implies a typical daily range of roughly 5.2 percent of spot, which is the unit of risk to size positions against.

**Momentum.** RSI(14) prints 66.9 — neutral territory; MACD (12/26/9) sits above its signal line (0.006189 vs 0.003737, histogram +0.002452), consistent with building momentum. Momentum readings are state descriptors, not trade signals on their own; the desk treats confluence between momentum and level location as the actionable unit.

**Volatility & liquidity.** 30-day realized volatility annualizes near 75%; the 20-day band spans 22% of the mid — expanded, which favors trend continuation tactics; 7-day turnover runs at 1.19x the trailing-month norm. Behavior around these regimes — absorption at band edges, volume confirmation on breaks — is what separates a tradeable move from noise.

**Performance context.** On longer windows the asset has returned +5.69% over 30 days and +57.99% over 90 days. Positioning decisions made on monthly horizons should respect these base rates instead of extrapolating the last week. The 7-session change (+14.65%) is the shortest window the desk treats as signal rather than noise.

sections.en:
**Bullish scenario.** Continuation higher requires continued holds of the 50-day average ($0.2040); RSI holding above 60 (currently 67). Under those conditions the path of least resistance flips to buy-the-dip, with prior resistance converting to support as the confirmation test.

**Bearish scenario.** Downside continuation triggers on a decisive loss of $0.2292. In that case failed support typically becomes the new ceiling, and momentum chasers provide the exit liquidity.

Net take on Cardano: spot $0.2392 with the medium-term bias constructive while price holds the relevant side of the 50-day average. The 24-hour tape (+9.26%) is consistent with that bias. Decision zones are the levels named in the technical section, not opinions: trade the reaction at those prices, not the headline of the day.
